_: THE PROVIDER CATALOG (Harness and Keys, owner 11-16; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-16-harness-and-keys-design.md): one row per provider an org can hold a key for, the ONE source of every fact about it. src/astryx/core/catalog.py is its only reader. `auth`: login (signed in through a harness) or key (pasted, billed per token). `speaks`: {format: endpoint} — the API formats it serves and where; a harness that speaks a format (cli_adapters.json `speaks`) can run on any key whose provider serves it. `native`: the format this provider IS (its endpoint is the harness's built-in one, so no base URL is set). `shape`: a regex the whole key must match. `check`: one free authenticated GET that tells a good key from a rejected one (auth: bearer | x-api-key | x-goog-api-key); absent = not checkable. `models`: what the picker offers, the first the default; `tiers`: the model each of the harness's tier aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) maps to on this provider. `custom`: the owner gives the endpoint. `billing`: subscription | metered (a metered key carries a daily cap). `usage`: oauth when its limits can be read (astryx.core.usage_refresh). What the Agents tab shows: `name`, `by`, `blurb`, `hex` (its mark's colour), `get` (where to make a key). Adding a provider is adding a row here.
